local pg=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
local old=pg:FindFirstChild("MinimapAcceptance")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local f=Instance.new("Folder");f.Name="MinimapAcceptance";f.Parent=pg
local event=game.ReplicatedStorage.GameRemotes.round_snapshot
local function record(s)
 local history={visited={},deaths={}}
 for _,v in s.minimap.visited do table.insert(history.visited,{id=v.id,kind=v.kind,position={v.position.X,v.position.Y,v.position.Z}}) end
 for _,v in s.minimap.deaths do table.insert(history.deaths,{id=v.id,kind=v.kind,position={v.position.X,v.position.Y,v.position.Z}}) end
 f:SetAttribute("Phase",s.phase);f:SetAttribute("RoundId",s.minimap.round_id);f:SetAttribute("Visited",#s.minimap.visited);f:SetAttribute("Deaths",#s.minimap.deaths);f:SetAttribute("History",game.HttpService:JSONEncode(history));f:SetAttribute("Stamina",s.stamina);f:SetAttribute("Sprinting",s.is_sprinting)
end
local c=event.OnClientEvent:Connect(record)
f.Destroying:Connect(function() c:Disconnect() end)
game.ReplicatedStorage.GameRemotes.request_round_action:FireServer("sync")
return "Acceptance observer attached to real snapshots"
